en.eNote: One logged day sits in the window: Thursday 1,845 kcal (P206/C132/F51) against the 2,200 training-day target, 355 short on a 16,980 kg hack-squat session. Friday through today carry no food log, so the chart plots the 2,000 kcal reference there. Active burn averaged 445 kcal/day and peaked at 688 on Thursday.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414. One day carries a real, measured balance: Thursday’s 1,845 kcal against 688 net exercise gives −1,257, final. Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday and today sit at the 2,000 kcal reference, so their bars are indicative only.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the one logged day: Thursday −1,257, final. The other six days have no food logged, so they stay out of the bridge. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Five sessions, 39,888 kg on three lifting days
en.i1: Five sessions, 6h 07m, 39,888 kg, 3,391 active kcal. Three lifting days carry the tonnage. Thursday’s hack squat is the heaviest piece: 83 minutes, 19 sets, 201 reps, 16,980 kg, avg HR 122, max 153, 752 active kcal. Tuesday’s deadlift day ran 76 minutes, 18 sets, 246 reps, 11,388 kg, avg HR 123, max 155, 712 active kcal. The two pool swims — 2,250 m Friday, 2,200 m Monday — add 1,323 kcal across 127 minutes.
en.i2: Tuesday’s barbell deadlift held 120 kg and hit 10 reps on all three working sets at RPE 9.5/8.5/9, after 60 kg × 6 and 100 kg × 6 warm-ups — the same top set as Sep 1. Session tonnage went 10,740 kg to 11,388 kg, up 6.0% on the same load, with avg HR 123 against 122 and max 155 against 157. Walking lunges carried 4 × 24 unloaded reps behind it.
en.i3t: Swim Sep 7: 2,200 m at 2:18 per 100 m
en.i3: Monday’s pool swim covered 2,200 m in 64 minutes as 10×100 + 10×50, averaging 2:18 per 100 m — two seconds off the 2:16 held on Aug 31 over the identical set, and level with the 2:18 of Aug 26. Avg HR 121, max 148, 661 active kcal, 27 strokes per minute over 88 lengths. Zagreb air ran 16.5–29.7 °C that day.
en.i4t: Recovery: HRV 39, the lowest of the seven
en.i4: Last night scored 77 on 6h 49m — three under Monday’s 80 and twelve minutes under the 7h 01m seven-night average. HRV read 39, eight below Monday’s 47 and 2.6 under the 28-day baseline of 41.6, the lowest of the seven nights on this board. RHR held at 53, two below Monday’s 55 and level with the seven-night mean. Readiness computes to 77.
en.rec: Tonnage over the last seven days is 39,888 kg across three lifting days, against 36,377 kg the week before, with the 28-day chronic load at 32,396 kg a week — an ACWR of 1.23, inside the ceiling. Flag: the hack squat top set went 170 kg × 12 on Aug 27 to 200 kg × 6 on Sep 3, a 17.6% load jump, and the next hack session is the one that has to absorb it. Next session: hack squat, 4 × 8 at 170 kg. Intake is the lever: Thursday logged 1,845 kcal against the 2,200 training-day target on a 16,980 kg session, and carbohydrate came in at 132 g against 212 g. Put the missing ~350 kcal into carbohydrate on lifting days.

hr.eNote: U prozoru je jedan zabilježeni dan unosa: četvrtak 1.845 kcal (P206/C132/F51) naspram cilja od 2.200 za dan treninga, 355 manje na treningu od 16.980 kg. Petak pa do danas nemaju zapis hrane, pa graf ondje crta referentnih 2.000 kcal. Aktivna potrošnja bila je prosječno 445 kcal/dan, s vrhom od 688 u četvrtak.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414. Jedan dan nosi stvarnu, izmjerenu bilancu: četvrtkovih 1.845 kcal naspram 688 neto treninga daje −1.257, konačno. Petak, subota, nedjelja, ponedjeljak, utorak i danas stoje na referentnih 2.000 kcal, pa su im stupci samo okvirni.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje jedan zabilježeni dan: četvrtak −1.257, konačno. Preostalih šest dana nema zabilježenu hranu pa ostaju izvan mosta. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Pet treninga, 39.888 kg u tri dana dizanja
hr.i1: Pet treninga, 6h 07m, 39.888 kg, 3.391 aktivnih kcal. Tonažu nose tri dana dizanja. Četvrtkov hack čučanj najteži je komad: 83 minute, 19 serija, 201 ponavljanje, 16.980 kg, prosj. HR 122, max 153, 752 aktivne kcal. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja trajao je 76 minuta, 18 serija, 246 ponavljanja, 11.388 kg, prosj. HR 123, max 155, 712 aktivnih kcal. Dva plivanja — 2.250 m u petak, 2.200 m u ponedjeljak — dodaju 1.323 kcal kroz 127 minuta.
hr.i2: Utorkovo mrtvo dizanje zadržalo je 120 kg i odradilo 10 ponavljanja u sve tri radne serije uz RPE 9,5/8,5/9, nakon zagrijavanja 60 kg × 6 i 100 kg × 6 — ista vršna serija kao 1.9. Tonaža treninga otišla je s 10.740 kg na 11.388 kg, više za 6,0% uz isto opterećenje, uz prosj. HR 123 naspram 122 i max 155 naspram 157. Iza toga su išli iskoraci u hodu, 4 × 24 ponavljanja bez opterećenja.
hr.i3: Ponedjeljkovo plivanje u bazenu prešlo je 2.200 m u 64 minute kao 10×100 + 10×50, prosječno 2:18 na 100 m — dvije sekunde iza 2:16 od 31.8. na istoj seriji i izjednačeno s 2:18 od 26.8. Prosj. HR 121, max 148, 661 aktivna kcal, 27 zaveslaja u minuti kroz 88 dužina. Zrak u Zagrebu bio je 16,5–29,7 °C toga dana.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 77 uz 6h 49m — tri manje od ponedjeljkovih 80 i dvanaest minuta ispod prosjeka od 7h 01m kroz sedam noći. HRV je bio 39, osam ispod ponedjeljkovih 47 i 2,6 ispod 28-dnevne osnove od 41,6, najniži od sedam noći na ovoj ploči. RHR je ostao na 53, dva ispod ponedjeljkovih 55 i izjednačen sa sedmodnevnim prosjekom. Spremnost se računa na 77.
hr.rec: Tonaža u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 39.888 kg kroz tri dana dizanja, naspram 36.377 kg tjedan prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 32.396 kg tjedno — ACWR 1,23, unutar stropa. Zastavica: vršna serija hack čučnja otišla je sa 170 kg × 12 od 27.8. na 200 kg × 6 od 3.9., skok opterećenja od 17,6%, a sljedeći hack trening je taj koji ga mora apsorbirati. Sljedeći trening: hack čučanj, 4 × 8 na 170 kg. Poluga je unos: četvrtak je zabilježio 1.845 kcal naspram cilja od 2.200 za dan treninga na treningu od 16.980 kg, a ugljikohidrati su bili 132 g naspram 212 g. Nedostajućih ~350 kcal stavi u ugljikohidrate na dane dizanja.
